rule: promotional price applies only inside its validity window
how_to_break_it: check out one minute after the end date

rule: price is computed on the server
how_to_break_it: send a lower unit price or total in the request
expected: server price used or request rejected

how_to_break_it: stack two discounts or apply one twice

rule: order can be dispatched only after approval
how_to_break_it: call dispatch on a submitted order
approve the same order twice or concurrently
order 0; negative; max + 1; decimal where integer expected
cancel a batch after invoicing then re-batch the orders

rule: invoice total equals the sum of its lines
how_to_break_it: edit a line; apply a discount; cancel a line

rule: payment cannot exceed the outstanding balance
how_to_break_it: pay balance + 0.01; pay the exact balance twice

rule: partial payments reduce the balance correctly
expected: balance and status correct after each step

how_to_break_it: double submit; retry after a client timeout

rule: overdue status reflects due date and unpaid balance
how_to_break_it: move the due date into the past; pay in full after overdue
expected: status correct everywhere it is shown

rule: returned quantity cannot exceed delivered quantity
how_to_break_it: return more than delivered; return the same items twice

rule: credit note matches the approved return
how_to_break_it: issue a credit above the return value

rule: dashboard totals equal the sum of records
how_to_break_it: compare totals after partial payments and returns

rule: deleting a parent does not orphan children
how_to_break_it: delete a customer or location with related records
expected: blocked or cascaded per spec; no orphans

how_to_break_it: import a file with invalid rows
expected: accepted plus rejected equals total rows

how_to_break_it: complete the same item repeatedly; replay the completion request
